episodes.title: Jehovah's Witnesses Are Quietly Preparing For Something Big!
episodes.description:
Are Jehovah’s Witnesses preparing for another major change? Recent developments have raised important questions about the future direction of the Watchtower organization.

In March 2026, Jehovah’s Witnesses announced an adjustment concerning the use of a patient’s own blood during medical procedures. 

Then, on September 18, the Governing Body announced another significant change: accepting red blood cells, white blood cells, plasma, or platelets from another person would become a matter of personal conscience. 

Why are these decisions changing now? 

How do they affect ordinary Jehovah’s Witnesses? 

And is there evidence of another major change on the horizon?

#JehovahsWitnesses #Watchtower #GoverningBody #JWNews #ExJW

episodes.title: How Did A Spanish Court Really Call Jehovah's Witnesses A “DESTRUCTIVE CULT”: Is This The Collapse?
episodes.description:
Did a Spanish court really declare Jehovah’s Witnesses a “destructive cult”?

The answer is more complicated than the headline suggests.

In 2023, Jehovah’s Witnesses in Spain took the Spanish Association of Victims of Jehovah’s Witnesses to court over statements describing the organization as a “destructive sect” and referring to former members as “victims.”

The case eventually reached the Madrid Provincial Court in 2026.

But what did the courts actually decide?

#JehovahsWitnesses #JehovahsWitnessesDocumentary #CourtCase
